title: A Collection of Papers, Which passed between the Late Learned Mr. Leibnitz, and Dr. Clarke, In the Years 1715 and 1716. Relating to the Principles of Natural Philosophy and Religion
note: Original 1717 edition of the 1715–1716 Leibniz–Clarke correspondence. Third Letter §4 formulates relational space as the order of coexistences, time as the order of successions, and the Principle of the Identity of Indiscernibles against Newtonian substantivalism.
